correctness.rationale: Finite simplicial fixed-space barycenters correspond to admissible reflection orbits; for even widths these are precisely edges of a 3×m half-grid with three terminal leaves, respecting pairwise matching compatibility. Reconstructed all five finite H_m matching-face universes and explicit toggle Morse pairings, with face totals 11, 66, 426, 2635, 16402; checked all Hasse directed covers (13, 144, 1378, 10976, 83597) and acyclicity, yielding critical profiles {0:1}, {0:1,2:1}, {0:1,3:1}, {0:1,4:4}, {0:1,5:11}. A unique 0-cell with only d≥2 cells gives the displayed wedges by Forman. This finite exhaustion proves precisely the five widths, not an all-width theorem.
